description.id: Tradisi lisan, mitologi kepulauan Nusantara yang kaya dari Jawa, Sunda, Bali, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi hingga Papua, memadukan animisme purba, Hindu-Buddha, dan pengaruh Islam.
description.en: Oral traditions and rich archipelagic folklore from Java, Sunda, Bali, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi to Papua, intertwining ancient animism, Hindu-Buddhist epics, and Islamic influences.

description.id: Kosmologi Shinto dan pengaruh Buddha yang memunculkan ribuan kami (dewata), yokai (makhluk supernatural unik), dan yurei (arwah penasaran).
description.en: Shinto cosmology and Buddhist traditions giving rise to thousands of kami (spirits/gods), yokai (supernatural entities), and yurei (restless spirits).

description.id: Kumpulan mitos dan ajaran Helenistik klasik tentang dewa-dewi Olimpus, titan purba, pahlawan legendaris, serta monster pembawa takdir.
description.en: Classical Hellenic lore concerning the Olympian deities, primordial Titans, legendary heroes, and monstrous beasts of fate.

description.id: Tradisi Skandinavia kuno tentang Yggdrasil, dewa Æsir dan Vanir, jötunn (raksasa es/api), dan peristiwa apokaliptik Ragnarök.
description.en: Ancient Scandinavian folklore centered on Yggdrasil the World Tree, the Æsir and Vanir gods, jötnar (frost and fire giants), and the doom of Ragnarök.

description.id: Tradisi Irlandia, Skotlandia, dan Wales tentang kaum Aos Sí (bangsa peri/makhluk dunia lain), banshee pembawa firasat, dan makhluk penunggu rawa.
description.en: Irish, Scottish, and Welsh traditions regarding the Aos Sí (otherworld beings), omens of the banshee, and shape-shifting water horses.

description.id: Kepercayaan lembah Sungai Nil tentang siklus kematian dan kebangkitan, penjaga dunia bawah tanah Duat, dan hibrida suci manusia-hewan.
description.en: Nile River valley beliefs centered on the cycles of cosmic order (Ma'at), guardians of the underworld (Duat), and sacred anthropomorphic deities.

description.id: Kosmologi Aztek dan Maya tentang ular berbulu Quetzalcoatl/Kukulkan, dewa jaguar, dan dunia bawah Xibalba.
description.en: Aztec and Maya cosmology featuring the feathered serpent Quetzalcoatl/Kukulkan, nocturnal jaguar spirits, and the labyrinthine underworld of Xibalba.

description.id: Kosmologi Taois dan tradisi lisan Dinasti Tiongkok kuno tentang naga penguasa cuaca (Long), burung abadi Fenghuang, dan siluman qilin.
description.en: Ancient Chinese folklore and Daoist cosmology of benevolent rain-bearing dragons (Long), celestial Fenghuang, and auspicious chimeras.

description.id: Cerita rakyat Eropa Timur seputar penjaga hutan Leshy, penyihir ambivalen Baba Yaga, dan makhluk air Rusalka.
description.en: Eastern European folklore surrounding woodland spirits like Leshy, the enigmatic hut-dwelling Baba Yaga, and liminal water maidens (Rusalka).

description.id: Tradisi orisinal Yoruba, Fon, Zulu, dan cerita rakyat trickster Anansi, makhluk rawa Mokele-mbembe, dan dewa pelindung.
description.en: Yoruba, Fon, and Sub-Saharan traditions featuring trickster Anansi the spider, river-dwelling cryptids, and nature spirits.

description.id: Kisah Seribu Satu Malam, bangsa Jin (Ifrit, Marid), burung raksasa Roc, dan burung legendaris Simurgh dari sastra Persia.
description.en: Arabian Nights folklore, classes of Jinn (Ifrit, Marid), the colossal mountain-lifting Roc bird, and the benevolent Persian Simurgh.

description.id: Epos Mahabharata dan Ramayana yang melahirkan Garuda penguasa angkasa, kaum naga, asura perkasa, dan yaksha penjaga bumi.
description.en: Vedic epics depicting solar raptor Garuda, serpentine Nagas, formidable Asuras, and earthly guardian Yakshas.

description.id: Cerita leluhur suku-suku Pribumi Amerika tentang Burung Petir (Thunderbird), peringatan moral tentang Wendigo, dan roh pelindung alam.
description.en: Indigenous tribal traditions of the storm-bearing Thunderbird, cautionary lore of the Wendigo, and sacred guardian totems.

description.id: Mitos kepulauan Filipina tentang Manananggal pemisah tubuh, Kapre penghuni pohon besar, dan Tikbalang berkepala kuda.
description.en: Philippine archipelagic lore of the viscera-sucking Manananggal, colossal tree-dwelling Kapre, and equine trickster Tikbalang.
